content_data.meeting_title: Content Strategy for Predictive Analytics Pilot Launch
agenda_items: Defining key performance indicators (KPIs) for content success
Resource allocation and content creation timeline for initial phase
Discussion of target audience personas for the pilot program
Review of current content landscape for predictive analytics in healthcare
key_decisions: Develop a series of blog posts, a white paper, and social media snippets for the pilot launch
Focus on two primary personas: Clinical Directors and Hospital Administrators for initial outreach
Content to emphasize patient outcomes, operational efficiency, and cost savings
action_items: Marketing Lead to finalize target audience persona profiles within three days
Design Team to mock up visual concepts for white paper by two weeks from now
Data Science Team to provide simplified use case examples for content by end of week
Content Writer to draft initial content brief for foundational blog posts by next week
Project Manager to schedule a follow-up content sync meeting for two weeks from now
